Nearly 28 yearsOf educational leadership ↗

A NEW SCHOOL. EXPERIENCED HANDS.

A beginning you
can believe in.

Nearly 28 years in education have shaped Dr. Rita Rattan’s belief that a happy childhood begins with feeling understood. Her experience brings together preschool leadership, classroom teaching, school administration and years of listening to parents.

She has worked with families at two preschools in Zirakpur—Bachpan Play School as Centre Head and DPS Play School in admissions counselling. That experience informs how Kabira welcomes young children, supports settling in and keeps parents involved.

“Every child needs to feel loved and understood before meaningful learning can begin.”

Experience that reaches beyond the classroom.

  • Guiding families through important decisions. Admissions roles at DPS Play School (2009–2015) and Carpe Diem International School (2017–2022) combined parent counselling, school coordination and careful record keeping.
  • Understanding how children learn. At Moti Ram Arya Senior Secondary School, she planned lessons, assessed progress and worked with fellow teachers to support learning.
  • Building organised, caring teams. Her centre leadership experience includes curriculum planning, staff supervision, recruitment and training, and bringing parents and teachers together.
  • Handling admission paperwork with care. From bonafide, character and transfer certificates to Visa NOCs and fee certificates, and timely online data submission on E-Punjab and CBSE portals—the detail-heavy side of admissions, done properly.
  • Recognised for communication, early on. A State-level award in an All India essay and handwriting competition—the same care for clear, thoughtful communication she brings to every parent conversation today.
10+ years

Helping families find their next step.

More than a decade across dedicated admissions roles, explaining programmes and supporting parents through enrolment.

10+ people

Experience leading a team.

Led a team of 10+ at the Bhavik IT & Management PTU study centre, with responsibility for staff recruitment, training and daily operations.

9 workshops

Continuing to learn, too.

Workshops and seminars from 2018–2022 covered parent communication, teaching approaches, student counselling and child safety awareness.

6 certificate types

Admission paperwork, handled properly.

From bonafide and transfer certificates to Visa NOCs and fee certificates for tax rebate, plus timely data submission on E-Punjab and CBSE portals.

Parents are part
of the conversation.

Dr. Rattan’s experience includes parent-teacher meetings, school events and daily coordination between families and staff. With English, Hindi and Punjabi among the languages she speaks, the aim is simple: clear conversations and a child who feels supported at school and at home.

A FEW THINGS YOU MAY BE WONDERING

Little questions.
Helpful answers.

Which programmes are available? +

We currently offer Pre-Nursery (2+ years), Nursery (3+), LKG (4+), UKG (5+) and Daycare. Higher classes are planned progressively, subject to enrolment, infrastructure and required permissions.

What are the preschool and daycare timings? +

Regular preschool hours are approximately 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM. Daycare is available from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Please discuss your family's requirements during your visit.

How do you balance play and academics? +

Our programme combines age-appropriate language, phonics and number concepts with creative play, movement, sensory exploration and social-emotional learning. Childhood is never rushed.

Can we visit before deciding on admission? +

Yes. We encourage families to visit the campus, experience the environment and discuss their child's needs with our admission counsellor before registration. You can find our address and directions below.

What documents may be needed for admission? +

You may be asked for your child's birth certificate, child and parent photographs, address proof, Aadhaar copies where applicable, previous school records if any and relevant medical information. The school will confirm the requirements during registration.
